methodology: Function-constructor object extraction from const MCQ_BANK_X arrays; Choices.{A,B,C,D} + CorrectChoice per item; string-aware analysis

PACK_A.B_bias_verdict: SYSTEMATIC — All sections B dominates (31-41%) except Section A

absoluteLanguage_DL003.note: Most uses are in intentionally-wrong distractor choices (e.g., 'always produces more accurate forecasts') — pedagogically legitimate

PACK_B.CC_balance_verdict: ACCEPTABLE — within CAQS §6.4 tolerances (22-28%) at pack level; minor per-section variation

rotationCloneGroups_DL012.verdict: CRITICAL — 452 of 500 items are rotation-group clones (DL-012 confirmed). Only 48 unique choice sets in the entire pack. The clone groups use 6-7 item rotation groups with CC cycling A-B-C-D-A-B-C. Distractors are identical across all items in each group, only CC position rotates.
CRITICAL — 432 of 500 items are rotation-group clones (DL-012 confirmed). 76 of 77 groups are consecutive. Same pipeline as Pack C.
CLEAN — Pack E has genuinely unique items (different authoring pipeline)

cross_pool.oneItemWith0Choices: Pack D has 1 item with no choice object (P1-FD-046 area)
cross_pool.CC_balance_verdict: ACCEPTABLE at pool level (B at 26.7% is slightly above target 25%, but within ±2% bound). Pool-level B-bias entirely attributable to Pack A (167/500 = 33.4%)

absoluteLanguage_DL003.note: Most uses intentional — e.g., 'always produces more accurate forecasts' as a wrong distractor is legitimate CMA pedagogy. Only 1 'impossible' and 11 'must' found pool-wide — low risk.

vagueQualifiers_DL004.verdict: ESSENTIALLY NONEXISTENT — 0 items have vague qualifiers in distractors across all 2,500 items

rotationCloneGroups_DL012.verdict: 933 items across the pool share identical non-correct-choice sets with at least 4 other items — the same distractors rotated among A/B/C/D. Packs C and D account for 94.7% of all clone items.

severity_HIGH.detail: 167/500 items have CC=B. All sections A-F except Section A show B dominating at 31-41%. CAQS §6.4 target is 22-28% per position. Systematic template rotation artifact.
severity_HIGH.affected_QIDs: All Pack A items with CC=B
severity_HIGH.recommendation: Audit Pack A section-level CC distribution and rebalance during next certification wave

severity_HIGH.detail: 452 of 500 items are rotation-group clones. 82 groups where 5-7 items share the identical 4 choices, only the CC letter rotates. Zero item discrimination within groups.
severity_HIGH.recommendation: Per DL-012 remediation proposal — archive 112 clones per DL-012 plan (not yet executed)

severity_HIGH.detail: 432 of 500 items are rotation-group clones. 77 groups (76 consecutive). Same pipeline as Pack C.

severity_MEDIUM.issue: Pack B Section A/D per-section CC imbalance
severity_MEDIUM.detail: Section A: B=27/75(36%), D=13/75(17%). Section D: B=13/75(17%), C=24/75(32%). Not severe at pack level but per-section variation exceeds CAQS target.
severity_MEDIUM.recommendation: Review Section A and D item sequence during next certification pass

severity_MEDIUM.issue: Pack A — 25.2% items have all-naked-number distractors
severity_MEDIUM.detail: 126 items where all distractors are bare dollar amounts (e.g., '$225,000', '$211,000', '$172,000'). These are calculation items where distractors are undifferentiated numbers — candidates must compute to distinguish. Pedagogically valid for calculation items.
severity_MEDIUM.recommendation: Accept for calculation-heavy items; review for conceptual items where this pattern appears

severity_MEDIUM.issue: Pack B — 19.6% items have all-naked-number distractors
severity_MEDIUM.detail: 98 items with all-naked-number distractors. Section A (financial reporting) and Section B (budgeting) dominate. Calculation items.
severity_MEDIUM.recommendation: Accept — consistent with calculation-focused nature of Sections A/B

severity_LOW.detail: 109 items have at least one pair of distractors with >70% word overlap. Most are calculation items with dollar amounts that differ only by the final digit (e.g., $51,000 vs $42,000). 3 items have all 3 distractor pairs above 0.7 (complete redundancy).
severity_LOW.example_QIDs: P1-BD-050 through 056 (7 consecutive items, identical choices rotated — pound amounts), P1-BC-041-046 (unit amounts)

severity_LOW.detail: Mean distractor length 19.3 chars (vs 37.4 for Pack A, 42.1 for Pack C). Pack E items frequently have single-phrase distractors (e.g., '10', '15', '20', '30%').
severity_LOW.recommendation: Review Pack E distractors during next certification wave — some may be too terse for effective learning

severity_LOW.issue: Absolute language in distractors — false-positive caution
severity_LOW.detail: 129 total absolute term hits. Most are intentionally wrong distractors: e.g., 'always produces more accurate forecasts', 'budgets can never change', 'variances are never investigated'. These are legitimate pedagogical tools that teach candidates to reject absolutist claims in accounting.
severity_LOW.recommendation: No action needed — most uses are in wrong-answer choices, not correct answers

severity_CLEAN.issue: DL-005 exact duplicate distractors — 0 across all 2,500 items
severity_CLEAN.detail: No item has two distractors that are text-identical. Excellent result.

severity_CLEAN.issue: DL-004 vague qualifiers — 0 items affected pool-wide
severity_CLEAN.detail: No distractors contain 'usually', 'normally', 'generally', or 'typically'. The pack authors have systematically avoided vague language.
No items have <3 or >3 distractors. 100% conform to the expected select-item format. One Pack D item (P1-FD-046 area) has no Choices object.

pipeline_quality_assessment.Pack_A_pipeline: Good educational quality but systematic CC B-bias. Rotation-clone patterns in Sections C/D/E (44 items). Best distractor length balance (mean 37 chars).
pipeline_quality_assessment.Pack_B_pipeline: Strongest educational quality. Minimal rotation clones (1 group, 5 items). Best per-pack CC distribution at aggregate. Good distractor length. 100% Certified.
pipeline_quality_assessment.Pack_C_pipeline: Massive clone problem (90.4%). Authoring pipeline produced rotation groups instead of unique items. Distractors are adequate length but undifferentiated across clone siblings.
pipeline_quality_assessment.Pack_D_pipeline: Same pipeline as Pack C — 86.4% clones. Identical structural patterns.
pipeline_quality_assessment.Pack_E_pipeline: Separate, better pipeline. Zero rotation clones. Well-balanced CC distribution. Very short distractors (most terse pack). Genuinely unique items.
